headline: Creative brief — Northwind spring retail campaign look
body: Warm terracotta and soft sage; lifestyle photography over product-only shots; mobile-first hero crops.
author: Priya Designer

headline: Brand guide — Northwind retail logo clearspace and color
body: Primary mark minimum 24px; clearspace 1x x-height; never recolor mark outside approved palette tokens.
author: Ada Admin

headline: Art direction — lifestyle photography mood board v2
body: Natural window light, shallow depth of field, hands in frame; avoid stock smiles and pure white backdrops.
author: Priya Designer

headline: Creative spec — Contoso Cloud icon set grid and stroke
body: 24px optical grid, 1.5px stroke, rounded terminals; export SVG + 2x PNG; dark-mode invert rules included.
author: Priya Designer

headline: Decision — freeze Contoso Cloud mark until Q4 launch
body: No logo redraws after 15 Jul; all request go through brand desk owner with launch checklist sign-off.
author: Ada Admin

headline: Creative brief — Contoso Cloud product page illustration set
body: Isometric scenes for pricing, security, and scale; brand blue accents only; no stock 3D marketplace assets.
author: Priya Designer

headline: Brand guide — Fabrikam Foods packaging type hierarchy
body: Display: Fraunces bold; body: Source Sans; nutrition panel fixed 8pt; allergen callouts always red accent.
author: Ada Admin

headline: Art direction — Fabrikam Foods summer packaging photo rules
body: Overhead food flat-lays preferred; prop styling limited to wood and linen; color grade toward warm daylight.
author: Priya Designer

headline: Creative spec — Fabrikam icon glyphs for shelf talkers
body: Monoline icons 32px, 2px stroke, single color on kraft; export SVG for print RIP and PNG for digital POS.
author: Priya Designer

headline: Creative brief — Adventure Works outdoor apparel lookbook
body: Trail and city dual context; real athletes; muted earth palette; avoid pure black backgrounds on hero.
author: Priya Designer

headline: Brand guide — Adventure Works secondary mark usage
body: Wordmark for light fields only; monogram for app icon and favicon; never stack wordmark under monogram.
author: Ada Admin

headline: Decision — pause Adventure Works pattern library expansion
body: No new pattern tiles until core color tokens ship; open issues tracked on brand desk until freeze lifts.
author: Marcus Reviewer
